title: Local tensor-train surrogates for quantum learning models
summary: A key bottleneck in quantum machine learning is the computational cost of repeated quantum circuit evaluations during the inference phase. To address this, we present a framework for constructing fast, cheap, provably accurate classical tensor-train surrogates of fully trained quantum machine learning models within local patches of their input data space. The approach combines Taylor polynomial approximation with a tensor-train (TT) representation and embeds it in a statistical learning paradigm via empirical risk minimization.
